performance.cable-capacity-basis: front channel: Cat 6 24 AWG, 0.235 in (5.97 mm), at the 30% recommended fill of its 33.6 sq in usable area; 387 at the 50% maximum fill - Panduit Space-Saving Cable Management Rack Systems bulletin RKCB46, Cable Capacity Charts

physical.cover-material: ABS with neodymium magnets and steel pins

base.description: The manager as Panduit ships PR2HF4WH, cover fitted.

cover-off.description: The same manager with its cover opened, the finger walls and the channel open to lay a cable in. The cover comes with the manager, so this is an illustration and not a device type.

datasheet.title: PatchRunner 2 Horizontal Cable Managers Spec Sheet RKSP188

description: 4RU front-only horizontal cable manager, Panduit PatchRunner 2 PR2HF4WH, white: an ABS moulding on the rack rails with a channel 181 mm deep standing out of its front, a wall of seven inset fingers along its top and another along its bottom with wide openings between them, and a dual-hinged magnetic cover across the finger tips that ships fitted. Two large windows in the plate pass cable to the back of the rack. It matches the depth of the PatchRunner 2 vertical managers it stands beside.

gaps.note: the specification sheet says the magnetic, dual-hinged cover opens 190 degrees up or down without being removed; no view draws a hinge, and the cover is drawn as one fitted plate that is either on or off.
gaps.wanted: a drawing or a close render of the cover's hinge

gaps.note: the drawing's table gives the overall cover height as 179.2 against the manager's 177.0; the cover is drawn at 177 and the 2.2 its lips stand over the body is not drawn.
gaps.wanted: a section through the cover and the body's top edge

gaps.note: the NM4B front-to-rear pass-through blanking panel (V10404BV-DC) is a separate accessory that closes the two windows; it is not drawn and the windows are open.
gaps.wanted: a drawing of the blanking panel fitted

gaps.note: the maker's PR2HF DXF (11 MB) and DWG were not read: the figures here come from the PDF drawing's table and its front view.
gaps.wanted: the DXF read for the finger and window measurements

body.description: the moulded plate and channel with its ears

cover.description: the dual-hinged magnetic cover across the finger tips, shipped fitted

fingers.description: the two walls of seven fingers, upper first

name: pr2hf4wh

attrs.note: datasheet - the material, colour, standards and what is in the box are the PR2HF4WH product page and the specification sheet (RKSP188); the materials of the cover (neodymium magnets, steel pins) are the drawing's.

bottom.note: drawing - the front view draws the same fingers along the bottom as along the top; the bottom is the top again.

capacity.note: datasheet - the Cable Capacity Charts of the Space-Saving bulletin (RKCB46) give the PR2HF4 per cable at the 30 per cent recommended fill and the 50 per cent maximum; the figure stated is the Cat 6 24 AWG 0.235 in (5.97 mm) column at 30 per cent, 232 (387 at 50 per cent). The Cable Capacity Calculator gives the usable area, 33.6 sq in.

chassis.note: drawing - 483.9 x 177.0 x 201.7. The table gives B 483.9 [19.05 in] over the ears, A 177.0 [6.97 in] high and C 201.7 [7.94 in] deep for the PR2HF4 (the specification sheet says 19.0 (484) and 7.9 (202)). The ears are the ends of the plate and are drawn with it, as the front view draws them; no part sits on them.

color.note: estimated - "The manager is white" on the PR2HF4WH page. Every image Panduit publishes of the part is a render; the cover is drawn a shade lighter than the moulding.

ears.note: drawing - `positions` states where the ears bolt, for the Rack Builder. The PR2HF customer drawing (Panduit 00224EAE-DC) tabulates the overall depth C 201.7 [7.94 in] and the mounting depth D 181.4 [7.14 in]: D is the front of the manager to the plane its ears bolt to, so the plate stands 20.3 behind it. `at` is 181.4. This states a placement; no dimension changed.

front.note: drawing - the front with the cover fitted: the cover, and under it the two rows of seven fingers, the channel between them and the two large windows in the plate behind it. The `duct` guide is the channel between the finger rows, 147 high (the 177 less two 15 mm rows, estimated) and the 419.9 between the plate's ear areas.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the part is 201.7 deep with 181.4 of it in front of the rails, so the rear face of its rack units stays free for another part.

guides.note: estimated - the duct is the channel between the two finger rows, run across the rack; its finger pitch, 72.8, is measured off the front view and the gap, 57.8, is that pitch less the 15 mm finger.

left.note: estimated - the side view of the drawing is a small outline; the end of the manager is built from the plan and the front view: the plate, and the two finger rows' walls.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DOCUMENTS. Panduit publishes the PR2HF as a customer drawing (PDF 00224EAE-DC with a table of heights, width, depths and weights; a DXF and a DWG that were not read), the PatchRunner 2 Horizontal Cable Managers specification sheet RKSP188, an installation instruction, a product page, the Space-Saving bulletin RKCB46 and the Cable Capacity Calculator. The customer drawing's front view is read at 300 dpi against its own height. THE FIGURES THE TABLE GIVES ARE `drawing`; EVERYTHING READ OFF THE PICTURE (the finger count, pitch and width, the windows) IS ESTIMATED and said so in the part that carries it.

rear.note: drawing - the back of the plate with its two windows, from the front view of the drawing, which draws them through the channel; five plates round them, sunk 0.05 inside the rear face so the plate closes the well within the 201.7 mm envelope. The windows are open: the blanking panel NM4B is a separate accessory (see `gaps:`).

right.note: estimated - the left view turned round.

shell.note: drawing - A HOLLOW CHANNEL, NOT A BOX, as the FS finger ducts are built. The body is a sheet body (docs/cable-managers-design.md section 4) and its six views are elevations. The solid is what its parts build: the plate on the front view as a well 181.4 deep whose floor is open at the two windows, the two walls of fingers standing in it, the cover in it across the finger tips, which opens and uncovers the channel, and the back of the plate standing 20.3 proud of the rear face.

thickness.note: estimated - no Panduit document states a wall gauge for the ABS moulding. 2.5 is a moulded wall of this size; the parts carry their own thicknesses.

top.note: drawing - the plan, rear at y=0: the plate 20.3 deep behind the ear plane and the seven fingers 150 mm long. The finger sizes are estimated.

weight.note: drawing - 1.2 kg [2.6 lb] unpacked, the weight table of the PR2HF customer drawing; the shipping weight is 1.5 kg.

references.title: Space-Saving Cable Management Rack Systems Product Bulletin RKCB46

guides.source: PR2HF customer drawing front view: seven fingers a row, pitch measured at 300 dpi, gap the pitch less the finger
